content: Even if you haven't read any of the books, you've probably heard of Dungeon Crawler Carl at this point. The LitRPG book series (a genre defined by its use of video game and tabletop RPG mechanics) by Matt Dinniman has become a cultural juggernaut, and it is only getting bigger. In addition to a television adaptation, Dungeon Crawler Carl is also getting another new adaptation in 2027.
